title: Geometric classification of primes modulo a (bend) congruence
summary: In this paper we continue the program to develop the algebraic foundations of tropical (algebraic) geometry. We give strong characterizations of prime congruences containing a given congruence on a toric semiring. We give four applications of this result. (1) We prove an analogue of the strong Nullstellensatz for congruences with finite tropical basis. This extends the existing result of Joó-Mincheva to cases, such as the bend congruence of a tropical(ized) ideal, where the congruence is not finitely generated.
